questions: Were you aware of everything happening during this episode?
Could you understand and respond to people during the episode?
Can you remember the entire episode afterward?
Did the episode begin suddenly and without warning?
Did you experience an unusual smell, taste, feeling of déjà vu, rising sensation in the abdomen, or intense fear just before it began?
Did the movements occur in essentially the same pattern during previous episodes?
Have you had similar episodes before?
Did anyone observe your eyes or head forcibly turning to one side?
Did you lose consciousness completely at any point?
Did you become confused, unusually sleepy, or have a severe headache afterward?
Did you bite your tongue during the episode?
Did you lose control of your bladder or bowels?
Did you fall or sustain an injury?
Did the episode occur during sleep or immediately after waking?
Could you stop or reduce the movements when someone asked you to?
Did the movements lessen when you were distracted?
Did emotional stress, pain, standing, or a frightening event immediately precede the episode?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed any medications?
Do you use alcohol or recreational drugs, or have you recently stopped using them?
Are you pregnant or could you be pregnant?
Have you ever been diagnosed with epilepsy or another neurological disorder?
Have you recently had a head injury, fever, infection, or stroke-like symptoms?
Do you currently have weakness, numbness, trouble speaking, or vision loss on one side?
Has anyone in your immediate family had epilepsy or unexplained sudden death?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Focal impaired-awareness seizure with tonic/dystonic posturing, caused by a left thalamic tuberculoma

Alternative 1: Functional neurological symptom disorder presenting as a psychogenic nonepileptic seizure

Alternative 2: Paroxysmal dystonic movement disorder secondary to the thalamic tuberculoma

Alternative 3: Focal seizure from an occult epileptogenic lesion not detected on routine MRI
